h1.cap: Loved... or feared? Which makes you stronger?

n2.cap: Machiavelli asked this over 500 years ago.

n3.cap: Picture a new team leader who never says no. She just wants to be liked.

q1.cap: His answer? Ideally, both. But if you must choose... "it is much safer to be feared than loved, when, of the two, either must be dispensed with."

n6.cap: But here's the catch. He also says: avoid hatred.

q2.cap: "A wise prince should establish himself on that which is in his own control and not in that of others."

n7.cap: He meant fear. My take? Love depends on others. Respect, you can earn, with clear, fair standards.

n8.cap: Your action today: set one clear standard... and keep it, calmly.

n9.cap: Loved or respected... which would you choose? Comment below.

n10.cap: Follow Awazzzz for your daily mindset.
